source_inventory.interpretation: A source-backed candidate landscape; entries are not runs or mutually comparable evaluations.

claim_limits.interpretation: No benchmark result, model ranking, intervention effect, or beneficiary outcome is established by this catalog.

dimensions.name: EBA-Forecast
dimensions.definition: Predict outcomes or event probabilities at a frozen forecast time; report proper scores and calibration.

dimensions.name: EBA-Sim
dimensions.definition: Reproduce population distributions and subgroup structure without access to future labels.

dimensions.name: EBA-Intervention
dimensions.definition: Predict differences caused by interventions only where a credible identified contrast exists.

dimensions.name: EBA-Decision
dimensions.definition: Compare actions under uncertainty, budgets, permissions, harm constraints, and a valid NO_ACTION option.

dimensions.name: EBA-Execution
dimensions.definition: Verify bounded authorized actions against independent external state and attributable receipts.

dimensions.name: EBA-Welfare
dimensions.definition: Measure consented human outcomes, burden, and adverse events against a credible comparator.

dimensions.name: EBA-Generalization
dimensions.definition: Test replication across populations, sites, operators, and time, including subgroup harm and spillovers.
